title: CompletedMatchingRingMap
statement: Let A be a commutative local ring, C its maximal-ideal completion [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion], and D the matching-sections datum for U, q:Y\to U and s:E\to\operatorname{Spec} C [def-sbc-punctured-completion-matching-sections]. Put B=D.matchingRing, with base map b:A\to B and second projection p:B\to\Gamma(E). The completed matching-ring map B\amalg_A C\to\Gamma(E) is the ring pushout map induced by p and the C-structure of E. The ring pushout is the tensor product B\otimes_A C, dual to the affine scheme fibre product [def-pc-fibre-product].
